description: Bitonic sort on a large array of random unsigned integers. O(n log^2 n) compare-and-swap network. Measures throughput in Melements/s.

scaling_param.name: size
scaling_param.description: Number of unsigned int elements to sort (must be power of 2)

non_scaling_params.name: iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: GPU thread-block size for bitonic sort steps

non_scaling_params.name: precision
non_scaling_params.description: Data type of elements to sort
